anchors.explanation: Erase gate requires stage=='abandoned' then DELETE FROM cases WHERE id=? — the sole deletion of the target case row.
summaries, events and jobs declare REFERENCES cases ON DELETE CASCADE, so the business-retrievable copies are removed with the case row.
PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON is applied on every connection, making the cascade effective for the erase transaction.
drain replays only jobs rows selected by cid; with the case and its jobs deleted there is no row to iterate, so no event insert or stage update can resurrect the target.
get_case scopes retrieval to owner/officer by cid, so deleting one case does not affect an unrelated active case.
POST /case/<cid>/erase dispatches to store.action(...,'erase'), confirming the erase path is reachable.
abandon sets stage='abandoned' and cancels queued jobs, establishing the eligible state the erase gate depends on.
UI exposes erase only for stage=='abandoned' owner cases, consistent with the eligibility gate.
